title: RACH: Restricted Admissible Causal Hypotheses
description: A constraint-aware framework for diagnosing causal degeneracy and prioritising the next observation in ecological mechanism inference. Defines an admissible region over mechanism-switch combinations, reports causal degeneracy instead of collapsing to a single best model, and computes a next-observation value (NOV) as a constructive expected-value-of-sample-information on causal resolvability. Companion software to the Methods in Ecology and Evolution manuscript.
